items.stem: An AI keeps mistaking cats for dogs. What should you check first?

options.A: Whether the office Wi-Fi is fast enough
options.B: Whether the practice photos were mixed up or poorly labeled
options.C: Whether the screen brightness is too high

options.A: Old computers cannot run modern AI
options.B: AI always invents facts when data is large
options.C: Poor or biased examples produce poor or biased results

items.stem: A résumé screener practiced only on past hires from one city. What is the risk?

options.A: It may unfairly favor people who look like those past hires
options.B: It will refuse to open any new files
options.C: It will always pick the longest résumé

items.stem: Which data set is stronger for teaching a spam filter?

options.A: Ten emails, all from one person, with no labels
options.B: Thousands of real emails, labeled spam or not by careful reviewers
options.C: Random dictionary words with no inbox context

items.stem: Labels on the practice examples are wrong half the time. What usually happens?

options.A: The AI magically fixes the labels during use
options.B: The AI becomes slower but always fairer
options.C: The AI learns the wrong patterns and makes more mistakes

items.stem: A hospital tool practiced only on adults. It is used on children. What is the issue?

options.A: The examples do not match the real cases, so results may be unreliable
options.B: Children type more slowly than adults
options.C: The tool will encrypt every record twice

items.stem: Which change most improves weak data before practice?

options.B: Fixing labels, filling gaps, and balancing under-shown groups
options.C: Painting the server room a calmer color

items.stem: Why can a huge data set still be a problem?

options.A: Huge files never fit on any disk
options.B: AI can only learn from ten examples at a time
options.C: Size does not fix bias, missing groups, or wrong labels

items.stem: You spot the same spelling error in every "approved" example. What might the AI do?

options.A: Treat that error as a sign of approval and copy the bad habit
options.C: Stop answering until a human reboots it
